# Rebild

Rebild is a Danish municipality (kommune) named in the AFDK-programme's (Atrieflimren i Danmark) documentation as part of a health cluster designation, "Klynge SYD" [^src1]. The AFDK programme is administered by Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram and, in the chapter where Rebild appears, documents Indicator 8 (Struktureret patientuddannelse) — structured patient education for atrial fibrillation — including a geographic overview of the Danish health clusters participating in the programme.

The mention of Rebild is thin: it appears only once in the corpus, listed alongside "Klynge SYD" without further elaboration [^src1]. No relationships, claims, or timeline events involving Rebild are recorded in the available data. Based on the source data, no further details are available beyond its listing as a municipality within Klynge SYD.
